verdict.rationale: As a server appliance, the DGX B200's BMC exposes both a Web user interface and programmatic interfaces (Redfish, IPMI, SNMP). Command-line health checks, nvidia-smi and node-wide GPU administration software also offer non-UI control. Nothing in the evidence states that these APIs match the Web UI feature for feature, so parity is only implied. Missing for 10: documented API/UI parity statement, a Redfish API reference showing coverage of all UI functions, and independent hands-on confirmation of full automation via API.
